body.condition: \(d_{\mathrm{BL}}\!\left(\mathcal L_P\{(R,\tau(X))\mid A=1,e(X)\leq t\},H\right)\leq C_{\mathrm{mark}}t^{\rho}\) for every \(0<t\leq t_0\).

novel.justification: Joint convergence is realistic when the outcome regressions and treated residual law vary continuously at a smooth propensity boundary. The explicit \(C^2\) Bernoulli subclass below satisfies it with a deterministic boundary law and order \(t\) error.
